Apple___healthy.symptoms: Vibrant uniform green coloration, intact cuticle, absence of chlorosis, necrosis, or foliar spotting.
Apple___healthy.environmental_triggers: Optimal sunlight, balanced soil nutrients, regulated drip irrigation.
Apple___healthy.organic_control: Routine compost tea applications, beneficial insect monitoring, balanced pruning.
Apple___healthy.chemical_control: No chemical intervention needed. Avoid unnecessary prophylactic spraying.
Apple___healthy.precautionary_measures: Maintain canopy aeration, monitor orchard perimeter for vector pests, ensure adequate drainage.

Apple___Apple_scab.symptoms: Olive-green to dark brown velvety circular spots on upper leaf surfaces, leaf puckering, premature defoliation.
Apple___Apple_scab.environmental_triggers: Cool, moist spring weather with temperatures between 13°C and 24°C and extended leaf wetness (>9 hours).
Apple___Apple_scab.organic_control: Sulfur-based fungicides, potassium bicarbonate, raking and composting fallen infected leaves.
Apple___Apple_scab.chemical_control: Myclobutanil, Captan, or Mancozeb applied strictly per regional agronomic guidelines.
Apple___Apple_scab.precautionary_measures: Prune tree canopy to maximize sunlight penetration and airflow; plant scab-resistant cultivars.

Apple___Black_rot.symptoms: Frog-eye leaf spots with brown centers and dark purple margins; can lead to fruit mummification and branch cankers.
Apple___Black_rot.environmental_triggers: Warm temperatures (26-30°C) with frequent rainfall and leaf wounding.
Apple___Black_rot.organic_control: Prune out dead wood and mummified fruit; apply bio-fungicide sprays containing Bacillus amyloliquefaciens.
Apple___Black_rot.chemical_control: Thiophanate-methyl, Captan, or Fludioxonil applications during early bloom.
Apple___Black_rot.precautionary_measures: Sanitize pruning shears with 70% ethanol between trees; dispose of infected cankered limbs off-site.

Corn___healthy.symptoms: Uniform emerald-green blade, upright foliage posture, no chlorotic striping or pustules.
Corn___healthy.environmental_triggers: Appropriate soil nitrogen levels, consistent moisture, 6-8 hours direct sunlight.
Corn___healthy.organic_control: Soil organic matter replenishment, cover cropping with legumes.
Corn___healthy.precautionary_measures: Maintain adequate field spacing to avoid moisture stagnation between plant rows.

Corn___Common_rust.symptoms: Oval to elongate cinnamon-brown powdery pustules on both upper and lower leaf surfaces, leaf chlorosis.
Corn___Common_rust.environmental_triggers: Moderate temperatures (16-25°C) and high relative humidity (>95%).
Corn___Common_rust.organic_control: Planting rust-resistant hybrids; neem oil extract application at first spot sighting.
Corn___Common_rust.chemical_control: Triazole or strobilurin fungicides (e.g., Pyraclostrobin, Azoxystrobin) applied when threshold reached.
Corn___Common_rust.precautionary_measures: Early planting to evade peak spore flight; rotate corn with non-host legume crops.

Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.symptoms: Long, elliptical grayish-green or tan lesions (cigar-shaped) expanding parallel to leaf veins.
Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.environmental_triggers: Moderate temperatures (18-27°C) accompanied by heavy dews and persistent overcast weather.
Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.organic_control: Deep tillage to bury crop debris; Trichoderma harzianum soil inoculation.
Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.chemical_control: Propiconazole or Azoxystrobin spray if lesions appear on the ear leaf before silking.
Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.precautionary_measures: 2-year minimum crop rotation with non-grasses; implement certified resistant hybrid seeds.

Pepper__bell___healthy.symptoms: Glossy green leaves, smooth margins, consistent venation pattern, firm texture.
Pepper__bell___healthy.environmental_triggers: Warm climate (21-29°C), well-drained loamy soil with neutral pH (6.2-7.0).
Pepper__bell___healthy.organic_control: Regular mulching with straw, vermicompost top-dressing.
Pepper__bell___healthy.precautionary_measures: Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation; practice wide plant spacing.

Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.causative_agent: Bacterium: Xanthomonas campestris pv. vesicatoria / Xanthomonas euvesicatoria
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small, water-soaked, circular to irregular lesions that turn dark brown with translucent greasy margins.
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.environmental_triggers: High temperatures (24-32°C) combined with frequent rain or overhead sprinkler irrigation.
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.organic_control: Fixed copper bactericides combined with plant-derived bio-elicitors; seed treatment with hot water (50°C for 25 min).
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.chemical_control: Copper hydroxide mixed with Mancozeb for improved bacterial control efficiency.
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.precautionary_measures: Strictly utilize certified pathogen-free seeds; eliminate solanaceous weed hosts (black nightshade).

Potato___healthy.symptoms: Compound pinnate leaves with bright green luster, sturdy petioles, no necrotic margin spotting.
Potato___healthy.environmental_triggers: Cool night temperatures (15-18°C), full sun exposure, hill mounding for tuber protection.
Potato___healthy.organic_control: Neem cake soil amendment, bio-fertilizer inoculation.
Potato___healthy.precautionary_measures: Routine visual inspection of lower canopies twice weekly during vegetative stage.

Potato___Early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown to black lesions with characteristic concentric target rings; older foliage infected first.
Potato___Early_blight.environmental_triggers: Alternating dry and humid spells with ambient temperatures between 24°C and 30°C.
Potato___Early_blight.organic_control: Bio-fungicides like Bacillus subtilis; liquid seaweed foliar spray to boost plant vigor.
Potato___Early_blight.chemical_control: Chlorothalonil, Mancozeb, or Difenoconazole applied at scheduled intervals.
Potato___Early_blight.precautionary_measures: Ensure optimal nitrogen nutrition; practice 3-year crop rotation out of solanaceous crops.

Potato___Late_blight.symptoms: Rapidly spreading water-soaked dark brown to purplish-black lesions; white fungal downy mildew on leaf undersides in high humidity.
Potato___Late_blight.environmental_triggers: Cool, wet conditions (10-21°C) with persistent relative humidity above 90%.
Potato___Late_blight.organic_control: Bordeaux mixture (copper sulfate + lime); immediate destruction of volunteer potato plants.
Potato___Late_blight.chemical_control: Metalaxyl, Cymoxanil, Dimethomorph, or Mandipropamid with rotational chemistries to avoid resistance.
Potato___Late_blight.precautionary_measures: Destroy cull piles; monitor regional late blight warning forecasts closely.

Tomato___healthy.symptoms: Deep green foliage with healthy trichomes (leaf hairs), robust leaflets without chlorosis or stunting.
Tomato___healthy.environmental_triggers: Warm temperatures (20-27°C), consistent soil moisture, adequate calcium availability.
Tomato___healthy.organic_control: Mulching with organic straw, vermicompost top-dressing, regular trellising.
Tomato___healthy.precautionary_measures: Use drip irrigation; ensure generous spacing between plants (45-60 cm) for air flow.

Tomato___Early_blight.symptoms: Small brown/black spots that develop concentric ring patterns (target-board appearance); yellow halos around lesions on lower leaves.
Tomato___Early_blight.environmental_triggers: Warm, humid conditions (24-29°C) following rainy spells or overhead irrigation.
Tomato___Early_blight.organic_control: Copper octanoate sprays; remove diseased lower leaves; apply Bacillus amyloliquefaciens.
Tomato___Early_blight.chemical_control: Mancozeb, Chlorothalonil, or Azoxystrobin applications as per label directions.
Tomato___Early_blight.precautionary_measures: Stake and prune lower foliage up to 30 cm from ground; mulch under plants to prevent soil splash.

Tomato___Late_blight.symptoms: Large, pale green to brown water-soaked blotches expanding rapidly; white fuzzy mold on leaf undersides; collapse of stem tissue.
Tomato___Late_blight.environmental_triggers: Cool, overcast, wet weather with high humidity (>90%) and temps of 15-22°C.
Tomato___Late_blight.organic_control: Bordeaux mixture; copper hydroxide sprays; prompt removal and incineration of infected vines.
Tomato___Late_blight.chemical_control: Mandipropamid, Fluopicolide, or Cyazofamid applied preventatively.
Tomato___Late_blight.precautionary_measures: Do not plant tomatoes in close proximity to potato fields; avoid night irrigation.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small (1-3 mm), dark, water-soaked circular spots with halos; infected leaves turn brown and drop prematurely.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.environmental_triggers: Warm, wet weather (24-30°C) with wind-driven rain or mechanical wounding during field handling.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.organic_control: Copper-based fungicides mixed with bacteriophage treatments; hot-water seed sanitation.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.chemical_control: Fixed copper compounds coupled with Mancozeb; acibenzolar-S-methyl (plant defense inducer).
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.precautionary_measures: Never work in tomato fields when foliage is wet; sanitize pruning tools with 10% bleach solution.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.symptoms: Pale green or yellowish spots with indefinite margins on upper surface; velvety olive-green downy mold on lower surface.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.environmental_triggers: High relative humidity (>85%) and moderate temperatures (21-24°C), predominantly inside greenhouse tunnels.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.organic_control: Aggressive greenhouse ventilation, sulfur vaporization, bio-fungicides.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.chemical_control: Difenoconazole, Chlorothalonil, or Boscalid per local university extension schedules.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.precautionary_measures: Increase row ventilation in polyhouses; reduce plant density; maintain relative humidity below 80%.
